blocking_findings: P2U1-1 [Blocker] ux-browser-review: .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html, the Print audit card, and harness/model-guide/preview.sh print_audit_block: the block omits the bias note. The data file harness/model-guide/data/print-audit-2026-11.json holds summary.bias_note = 'A Sonnet 5.5 session wrote the answer key, so the s55 score may be too high. Review A noted E35 for s55 is partial, not found (minors found 5, not 6).' The block renders only the top-level note, the scope note 'Seeded-error answer key of one unreleased book proof...', and the string 'wrote the answer key' appears 0 times in the served page. Rationale: spec D17 'The page' requires the block to show the two results, the error types with their counts, and the bias note, and the Phase 2 UX check of test-strategy.md line 455-460 lists the bias note as required; the page shows 'claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5#high 13 of 13' with no caveat that the same family wrote the answer key. The unit test T1 of preview-gate.test.ts passes only because the synthetic fixture sets its top-level note to a calibration sentence while the real top-level note is a scope note. Fix: render audit.summary.bias_note in the block, and read the bias note from the summary in the test.
